contract: Every required source, mutable UI output, and install QA artifact must have a matching on-disk SHA-256 and an explicit approval before its consuming gate can pass.

phase_2_nine_idle_keys.manual_gate: At least 12 of 16 facings recognizable without labels; stable construction and identity; rear hemisphere has no face, shirt, or tie leakage.

phase_3_sw_n_walk_proofs.manual_gate: Approve raw/processed SW and N strips plus both quarter-speed loops for stable identity, outfit construction, facing, gait, foot exchange, and loop closure.

phase_4_remaining_locomotion.manual_gate: Approve the 27 remaining idle masters and all nine quarter-speed walk loops for stable identity, outfit construction, facing, gait, foot exchange, and loop closure.

phase_5_ne_seated_chain.manual_gate: Approve the processed NE seated idle and stand-up chain for stable identity, coat construction, rear-right facing, smooth rise, and chairless silhouettes before SE generation.

phase_5_se_seated_chain.manual_gate: Approve the processed SE seated idle and stand-up chain for stable identity, coat construction, front-right facing, smooth rise, chairless silhouettes, and exact reverse sit-down.

phase_6_smooth_paperdoll_and_scene_qa.manual_gate: Approve the refreshed portrait-first paperdoll, inventory scale comparison, warm-office and cool-city actor read, clean chroma edges, and the one-world-chair desk scene.
